properties.name: header_height
properties.comment: The header content's height, 0 to 4096 (std::invalid_argument otherwise; nonzero needs header content); a view onto the list's layout. A change re-lays out the rows.
hand: a view onto the layout state; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out

properties.name: label_width
properties.comment: The label column's width, 40 to 320 (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a view onto the list's layout. A change re-lays out the rows.
hand: a view onto the layout state; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The rows' font (Font); a view onto the list's typography, which follows the theme until written. A write marks the font as set from code, passes it to the editors and re-lays out; an invalid FontSpec throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto the typography (the theme's until overridden); write_view applies it to the editors

properties.name: row_height
properties.comment: Each row's height, above 0 and at most 4096 (std::invalid_argument otherwise); a view onto the list's layout. A change re-lays out the rows.
hand: a view onto the layout state; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out

properties.name: scroll_offset
properties.comment: How far the rows are scrolled; a view onto the list's scroll state. A write is clamped to the content's overflow; a value that is not finite throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto the scroll state, which the list also moves itself; write_view clamps

not_properties.name: groups
not_properties.reason: a collection; stays methods (W owns collections)

not_properties.name: header_content
not_properties.reason: a child slot set with its height

not_properties.name: value
not_properties.reason: per-row state with a row argument
